Title: Ajay and the Family

Cast

1. Ajay - 34 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Kavita - 29 years, daughter
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Sunita - 58 years, mother
Look: green saree
4. Karan - 61 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Ajay stands by the road. Sunita stands near him.]

Ajay: "Let's do something fun today."

[Ajay rides his motorbike to the market.]

Ajay: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Ajay starts his scooter and rides off.]

Sunita: "One more time!"

[Ajay drives the car to the office.]

Ajay (happily): "That's great!"

[Ajay gets out of the car.]

Ajay: "That's great!"

Scene 2: The terrace - Day

[Kavita stands on the terrace. Ajay, Sunita and Karan stand near her.]

Ajay: "So, here we are!"

[Kavita hangs the wet clothes on the line.]

Karan: "Let's see."

[Ajay ties a letter to the pigeon and lets it fly.]

Ajay: "Oh wow!"

[Ajay reads the letter the pigeon brought.]

Kavita (softly): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Ajay falls from the ladder and hurts his leg.]

Ajay: "Hmm, I see."

[Ajay falls from the roof and dies.]

Karan: "Rest in peace."
